summary: NetClass Technology Inc, a Singapore-domiciled foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing a registered direct offering priced at $0.40 per Class A ordinary share. The November 5, 2026 securities purchase agreement with a single investor covered 675,000 shares, pre-funded warrants for 2,325,000 shares at $0.0125 exercise, and 3,000,000 allocation rights exercisable within 30 days at the same $0.40/$0.3875 pricing. Gross proceeds were approximately $1.2 million; Univest Securities served as exclusive placement agent for a 7% cash fee plus up to $60,000 expense reimbursement. This is an ordinary shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution and the near-term allocation-right overhang.
